sections.title: Restaurants & Consumer
sections.note: Census food services & drinking places sales (SA, nominal); real sales are a computed proxy: nominal sales divided by CPI food away from home (SA), so y/y ≈ volume growth. Restaurant employment is BLS CES food services & drinking places (SA). Bank of America Institute Consumer Checkpoint card data was evaluated but is not included: its restaurant figures are published only inside chart images in monthly PDFs, with no data download.

panels.title: Restaurant sales y/y: nominal vs. real (computed proxy) vs. menu prices
Restaurant employment, y/y
labels: Food services & drinking places jobs, y/y

auctions.note: Coupon auctions (notes and bonds, including TIPS and 2Y FRNs) from Treasury Fiscal Data (auctions_query); upcoming auctions from TreasuryDirect. Takedown shares are % of competitive awards. 'vs avg' compares each auction with the average of the previous 6 auctions of the same tenor (reopenings counted under their original tenor). Flag: weak = bid-to-cover at least 0.10 below average or primary-dealer takedown at least 3 pp above; strong = bid-to-cover at least 0.10 above or dealer takedown at least 3 pp below (an auction meeting both a weak and a strong test counts as weak unless it is strong on both). Tails vs. when-issued are not shown: free WI yields are not available.
